messages.paused: This feature is paused while your server is blacklisted from Niko.
messages.blacklist_body: Niko's features have been switched off for this server. Saved settings, polls, giveaways and the starboard are kept: if an appeal is approved they come back as they were, except the social notifier, which the server turns back on itself in the dashboard.
messages.blacklist_appeal: Submit an appeal at {url}, or contact Niko support for clarification.
